title: SAT语法
description: 按句界、标点、主谓一致、代词、修饰语、动词、句法、平行结构、所有格与比较系统整理。

source.scope: 基于 985 道去重题目的知识体系重构

chapters.label: 第1章
chapters.title: 语法题总解题框架
intro: 绝大多数SAT语法题都可以用“找谓语 - 划分分句 - 判断空格功能 - 检查语意”四步完成。

rules.title: 第一步：圈出所有限定动词
rules.core: 限定动词会随主语、时态或语态变化，能够承担一个分句的谓语；不定式、动名词和分词通常不能单独构成谓语。
rules.method: 先找 can/is/has/was 等助动词，再找实义动词；每个完整分句通常需要一个谓语中心。

examples.correct: The experiment reveals a pattern.
examples.incorrect: The experiment revealing a pattern.

rules.trap: 看到 -ing 或 -ed 形式不要直接当作谓语，先检查前面是否有助动词。

rules.title: 第二步：判断每一侧是不是独立分句
rules.core: 独立分句通常具备主语、限定动词和完整意思；从属连词或关系词引导的结构即使有主谓，也通常不能独立成句。
rules.method: 把空格左右分别遮住，检查是否都能单独成为一句完整陈述。

examples.correct: The sample was small; the result was clear.
examples.incorrect: Although the sample was small. The result was clear.

rules.trap: 含 although, because, when, which, who 等开头的结构常是从属成分。

rules.title: 第三步：确定空格的语法角色
rules.core: 空格可能需要谓语、非谓语、代词、所有格、连接词或标点。先定角色，再比较选项，效率远高于逐项翻译。
rules.method: 观察空格前后：前面是主语吗？后面已有谓语吗？空格是否位于两个完整句之间？

examples.correct: Researchers found that the method works.
examples.incorrect: Researchers finding that the method works.

rules.trap: 四个选项若只在词形或标点上变化，题目主要考结构，不是词义。

rules.title: 第四步：最后检查语意与指代
rules.core: 语法形式正确后，还要确认逻辑主体、时间关系、主动被动和代词指向合理。
rules.method: 把完整答案放回原句，问“谁做动作”“动作发生在何时”“代词指谁”。

examples.correct: After reviewing the data, the scientists revised the model.
examples.incorrect: After reviewing the data, the model was revised by the scientists.

rules.trap: 后一句语法表面可通，但开头修饰语错误地修饰了 model。

rows: 主语，动作或状态的承担者。
补语，用来说明主语或宾语。
从属分句，不能独立成句。
短语，没有完整的主语+限定动词结构。
修饰语，必须与被修饰对象在逻辑和位置上匹配。

sections.title: 1.3 先结构、后含义的淘汰顺序

items: 先删除会造成句子残缺、逗号拼接或重复谓语的选项。
再检查主谓一致、代词单复数、主动被动和时态。
再检查标点是否成对、冒号前是否完整、分号两侧是否完整。
最后才比较语意细节；语法题通常不需要理解所有专业词汇。

chapters.label: 第2章
chapters.title: 分句、句界与连接方式
intro: 本章解决独立分句、从属分句、逗号拼接、粘连句和连接副词等高频考点。

headers: 原PDF重点：G0011-G0070“句界与独立分句”、G0899-G0900，以及部分“标点选择/句法与语意完整性”题。

rules.title: 独立分句与完整句
rules.core: 独立分句必须有主语、限定动词和完整意思；祈使句的主语 you 可以省略。
rules.method: 空格两侧若都能独立成句，需要强连接标点。

examples.correct: The instrument measures salinity.
examples.incorrect: Measuring salinity in the upper ocean.

rules.trap: 分词短语即使很长，也不是完整句。

rules.title: 从属分句不能独立成句
rules.core: because, although, when, while, if, since, unless 等引导的从句需要依附主句。
rules.method: 从属词一出现，该分句的“独立性”被取消。

examples.correct: Although the sample was small, the result was reliable.
examples.incorrect: Although the sample was small.

rules.trap: 不要用句号或分号把从属分句单独切开。

rules.title: 句号和分号的等价关系
rules.core: 句号和分号都能连接两个独立分句；分号表示两句关系较紧密。
rules.method: 若两个选项仅在句号/分号间变化且两侧都是完整句，它们通常在纯语法上同等有效，题目会用其他细节区分。

examples.correct: The method is efficient; it is inexpensive.
examples.incorrect: The method is efficient, it is inexpensive.

rules.trap: 逗号不能单独连接两个独立分句。

rules.title: 逗号 + FANBOYS
rules.core: 两个独立分句可用逗号加并列连词 for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so 连接。
rules.method: 检查逗号后是否有真正的并列连词，而不是 however/therefore 之类副词。

examples.correct: The data were limited, but the trend was clear.
examples.incorrect: The data were limited, however the trend was clear.

rules.trap: however 不是 FANBOYS，不能只靠前面的逗号连接两句。

rules.title: 逗号拼接 (comma splice)
rules.core: 仅用逗号连接两个独立分句属于错误。
rules.method: 把逗号换成句号、分号，或加 FANBOYS。

examples.correct: The theory was influential; later evidence challenged it.
examples.incorrect: The theory was influential, later evidence challenged it.

rules.trap: 遇到“IC, IC”优先判错。

rules.title: 粘连句 (fused sentence)
rules.core: 两个独立分句之间完全没有标点或连接词，也属于错误。
rules.method: 数谓语并寻找句界；若出现两个完整主干却没有连接方式，就是粘连句。

examples.correct: The species is rare. It survives in isolated habitats.
examples.incorrect: The species is rare it survives in isolated habitats.

rules.trap: 长主语和插入语会掩盖第二个谓语。

rules.title: 前置从属分句后的逗号
rules.core: 从属分句位于句首时，通常用逗号与主句隔开。
rules.method: 先找到从属分句结束位置，再放逗号。

examples.correct: When the temperature rises, the reaction accelerates.
examples.incorrect: When the temperature rises the reaction accelerates.

rules.trap: 短从属分句有时可省逗号，但SAT标准题通常保留清晰边界。

rules.title: 后置从属分句的标点
rules.core: 主句在前、必要的从属分句在后时，通常不加逗号；表示强烈对比或非必要补充时才可能加。
rules.method: 问后半部分是否限定主句含义。

examples.correct: The reaction slows because the solution cools.
examples.incorrect: The reaction slows, because the solution cools.

rules.trap: because 从句通常是必要原因说明，不宜随意加逗号。

rules.title: 连接副词的标准结构
rules.core: however, therefore, moreover, nevertheless, consequently, instead, otherwise 等连接两个独立分句时，常用“IC; however, IC”。
rules.method: 连接副词前用分号/句号，后用逗号。

examples.correct: The sample was small; however, the result was consistent.
examples.incorrect: The sample was small, however, the result was consistent.

rules.trap: 不要把连接副词当并列连词。

rules.title: 连接副词作句内插入语
rules.core: however 等也可放在一个分句内部，此时用一对逗号隔开，不负责连接两个句子。
rules.method: 删除插入语后，剩余句子仍应完整。

examples.correct: The result, however, remained uncertain.
examples.incorrect: The result; however, remained uncertain.

rules.trap: 句内插入语不能用分号切断主干。

rules.title: 并列谓语不等于两个独立分句
rules.core: 同一主语控制两个谓语时，通常不需要在 and/but 前加逗号，除非句子很长或需强调。
rules.method: 检查第二个动词前是否出现了新的主语。

examples.correct: The device collects data and transmits them.
examples.incorrect: The device collects data, and transmits them.

rules.trap: 有共同主语时不要机械套用“逗号+and”。

rules.title: 并列宾语、表语和短语
rules.core: 并列的词或短语不构成独立分句，不能用分号或句号分开。
rules.method: 数主语和限定动词，不要只看句子长度。

examples.correct: The study examined cost, speed, and accuracy.
examples.incorrect: The study examined cost; speed; and accuracy.

rules.trap: 普通列表用逗号，不用分号，除非列表项内部已有逗号。

chapters.label: 第3章
chapters.title: 逗号、插入语与补充成分
intro: 本章核心是区分必要成分与非必要成分，并掌握成对标点。

rules.title: 主语与谓语之间不能随意加标点
rules.core: 完整主语与其谓语直接相连时，不能插入逗号、分号、冒号或破折号。
rules.method: 找主语中心词和第一个真正谓语；中间即使有很长修饰语，也不能把主语切断。

examples.correct: The number of species in the orchard has decreased.
examples.incorrect: The number of species in the orchard, has decreased.

rules.trap: 介词短语会把主语拉长，但不改变主谓关系。

rules.title: 谓语与宾语/补语之间不能加逗号
rules.core: 动词与其直接宾语、主语补语或宾语补语之间通常不加标点。
rules.method: 删除修饰语后检查“动词 + 必要成分”是否被切断。

examples.correct: The study revealed a clear pattern.
examples.incorrect: The study revealed, a clear pattern.

rules.trap: 冒号也不能直接放在动词后引出宾语列表。

rules.title: 介词与宾语之间不能加标点
rules.core: 介词必须直接支配名词、代词或动名词，不能被逗号或冒号隔开。
rules.method: 寻找 of, in, by, with, from, to 等介词。

examples.correct: The method depends on accurate measurements.
examples.incorrect: The method depends on, accurate measurements.

rules.trap: 长介词短语常被误判为插入语。

rules.title: 句首引导成分后的逗号
rules.core: 较长的介词短语、分词短语、不定式短语或副词从句位于句首时，通常用逗号与主句隔开。
rules.method: 先找到主句的主语；主语之前的整体通常是引导成分。

examples.correct: After analyzing the samples, the team revised the model.
examples.incorrect: After analyzing the samples the team revised the model.

rules.trap: 逗号位置应落在整个引导成分之后。

rules.title: 非限制性关系从句
rules.core: 只提供附加信息、删除后仍能明确指代的关系从句，用逗号成对隔开，常由 which/who 引导。
rules.method: 删除从句，检查核心名词是否仍唯一明确。

examples.correct: The telescope, which was installed in 2020, detected the signal.
examples.incorrect: The telescope which was installed in 2020, detected the signal.

rules.trap: 成对标点不能只出现一边。

rules.title: 限制性关系从句
rules.core: 用于确定“是哪一个”的必要从句通常不加逗号；美式考试中常用 that 指物。
rules.method: 如果删除从句后指代范围改变或不清楚，该从句通常是限制性的。

examples.correct: The telescope that detected the signal was newly installed.
examples.incorrect: The telescope, that detected the signal, was newly installed.

rules.trap: that 引导的限制性从句通常不用逗号。

rules.title: 非限制性同位语
rules.core: 同位语对前面的名词作补充说明，删除后句子仍完整时，用一对逗号或一对破折号隔开。
rules.method: 把同位语暂时删除，检查主干。

examples.correct: Maya Lin, an American architect, designed the memorial.
examples.incorrect: Maya Lin an American architect, designed the memorial.

rules.trap: 必须使用成对标点，不能只封闭一侧。

rules.title: 必要同位语：头衔 + 姓名
rules.core: 头衔或类别词用于识别人名时通常不加逗号，如 novelist Toni Morrison。
rules.method: 问姓名是否是必要识别信息。

examples.correct: The novelist Toni Morrison won the prize.
examples.incorrect: The novelist, Toni Morrison, won the prize.

rules.trap: 若前面是泛指头衔，姓名通常不能被当作可删除插入语。

rules.title: 姓名后的补充头衔
rules.core: 姓名已经唯一确定对象，后接职业、身份或说明时通常属于非必要信息，要用逗号隔开。
rules.method: 先看姓名本身是否足以识别。

examples.correct: Toni Morrison, a novelist, won the prize.
examples.incorrect: Toni Morrison a novelist won the prize.

rules.trap: 同一组词在不同位置可能从必要信息变成补充信息。

rules.title: 插入性连接词
rules.core: however, therefore, for example, in fact, moreover, of course 等位于句内时，用一对逗号隔开。
rules.method: 删除插入语后主干仍应通顺。

examples.correct: The method, for example, can detect small changes.
examples.incorrect: The method for example, can detect small changes.

rules.trap: 句首插入语一般只需后置逗号。

rules.title: 列举中的逗号
rules.core: 三个或以上并列成分用逗号分隔；SAT通常接受并鼓励最后一项前的系列逗号。
rules.method: 确保并列项处于同一语法层级。

examples.correct: The device measures temperature, pressure, and salinity.
examples.incorrect: The device measures temperature pressure, and salinity.

rules.trap: 逗号不能替代缺失的并列连词结构。

rules.title: 并列形容词与累积形容词
rules.core: 可互换顺序且可用 and 连接的并列形容词之间加逗号；层层限定的累积形容词不加。
rules.method: 尝试交换形容词顺序或加入 and。

examples.correct: a clear, concise explanation
examples.incorrect: a small, wooden box

rules.trap: “wooden small box”不自然，因此 small wooden 通常是累积修饰。

rules.title: 成对标点必须匹配
rules.core: 逗号、破折号或括号引出的非必要成分通常需要同类标点关闭。
rules.method: 从左侧标点开始，寻找对应的右侧边界。

examples.correct: The alloy - unlike pure aluminum - resists corrosion.
examples.incorrect: The alloy - unlike pure aluminum, resists corrosion.

rules.trap: 不要混用“逗号开、破折号关”。

chapters.label: 第4章
chapters.title: 分号、冒号、破折号与综合标点
intro: 强标点的使用取决于空格前后的句法完整性，而不是停顿长短。

headers: 原PDF重点：G0011-G0138“句界/插入语/标点选择”。

rules.title: 分号连接两个独立分句
rules.core: 分号两侧必须都能独立成句；它不能连接完整句与短语。
rules.method: 把分号替换成句号，若两边都成立，结构才可能正确。

examples.correct: The evidence was limited; the conclusion was cautious.
examples.incorrect: The evidence was limited; because the sample was small.

rules.trap: 分号后若以 because/although/which 开头，通常不是独立句。

rules.title: 分号分隔复杂列表
rules.core: 当列表项内部已有逗号时，可用分号分隔大项，避免层级混乱。
rules.method: 先识别每个大项是否自身含逗号。

examples.correct: The team visited Lima, Peru; Accra, Ghana; and Oslo, Norway.
examples.incorrect: The team visited Lima, Peru, Accra, Ghana, and Oslo, Norway.

rules.trap: 普通单词列表不需要分号。

rules.title: 冒号前必须是完整分句
rules.core: 冒号用于引出解释、例子、列表、定义或强调，冒号前必须语法完整。
rules.method: 遮住冒号后的内容，前半句应能独立成立。

examples.correct: The study examined three variables: cost, speed, and accuracy.
examples.incorrect: The study examined: cost, speed, and accuracy.

rules.trap: 动词 examined 的宾语不能被冒号切断。

rules.title: 冒号后的内容形式灵活
rules.core: 冒号后可以是单词、短语、列表或完整句，只要它说明或展开前面的完整陈述。
rules.method: 检查后半部分是否回答“具体是什么/为什么/例如什么”。

examples.correct: The result was unexpected: no sample showed contamination.
examples.incorrect: The result was unexpected; no contamination.

rules.trap: 后者语法可另成句，但不表达“解释/展开”的冒号关系。

rules.title: 破折号引出强调或解释
rules.core: 单个破折号可在完整句后引出强调性补充，功能接近冒号；一对破折号可包围插入语。
rules.method: 区分“单破折号引出尾部补充”和“双破折号包围句中插入”。

examples.correct: One feature mattered most - reliability.
examples.incorrect: One feature - mattered most reliability.

rules.trap: 破折号不能随意切断主谓或动宾。

rules.title: 冒号与 such as / including 不重复
rules.core: such as、including、for example 等本身已引出例子，前面通常不再用冒号，除非冒号前已经是完整句且后面结构另有需要。
rules.method: 检查冒号是否直接跟在动词、介词或引例词之前。

examples.correct: The collection includes minerals such as quartz and mica.
examples.incorrect: The collection includes: minerals such as quartz and mica.

rules.trap: “includes”后需要直接接宾语。

rules.title: 句号/分号与大写规则
rules.core: 句号后开启新句，首词通常大写；分号后若不是专有名词，通常小写。
rules.method: 比较选项中的标点与后续首字母大小写是否配套。

examples.correct: The method failed. However, the team tried again.
examples.incorrect: The method failed; However, the team tried again.

rules.trap: 连接副词在分号后通常小写 however。

rules.title: 标点等价陷阱
rules.core: 句号与分号、冒号与单破折号在部分结构中功能接近；若多个选项都能成立，要继续检查后面的大小写、连接词和成分完整性。
rules.method: 不要只凭“停顿感”选标点。

examples.correct: The finding was clear: the model needed revision.
examples.incorrect: The finding was clear, the model needed revision.

rules.trap: 逗号永远不能凭语气代替强标点。

chapters.label: 第5章
chapters.title: 主谓一致
intro: 核心不是看离动词最近的名词，而是找到真正的主语中心词。

headers: 原PDF重点：G0143-G0186（44题），并在G0342-G0898等混合标签中反复出现。

rules.title: 单数主语与复数主语
rules.core: 一般现在时中，第三人称单数主语用 -s 形式；复数主语和 I/you 用动词原形。be 动词单独变化。
rules.method: 先把主语替换成 it 或 they。

examples.correct: The device measures pressure. / The devices measure pressure.
examples.incorrect: The devices measures pressure.

rules.trap: 不要被主语后面的复数名词干扰。

rules.title: 介词短语中的名词不决定谓语
rules.core: of, in, with, among 等介词短语通常只是修饰主语，谓语与介词前的中心词一致。
rules.method: 删除介词短语后再判断。

examples.correct: The number of applicants is increasing.
examples.incorrect: The number of applicants are increasing.

rules.trap: 真正主语是 number，不是 applicants。

rules.title: 插入语和同位语不改变主语
rules.core: including, along with, together with, as well as, in addition to 等附加成分不构成并列主语。
rules.method: 删除附加成分。

examples.correct: The lead researcher, along with two assistants, is presenting.
examples.incorrect: The lead researcher, along with two assistants, are presenting.

rules.trap: 看到 with 不要自动按复数处理。

rules.title: and 连接的并列主语
rules.core: 两个不同的人或物由 and 连接时通常用复数谓语；若整体表示一个概念、一道菜或一个单位，可用单数。
rules.method: 判断是两个独立实体还是固定整体。

examples.correct: Speed and accuracy are important.
examples.incorrect: Speed and accuracy is important.

rules.trap: 固定整体如 bread and butter 可按语意为单数。

rules.title: or / nor / either...or / neither...nor
rules.core: 由 or/nor 连接的主语，谓语通常与离它最近的主语一致。
rules.method: 看动词左边最近的并列主语。

examples.correct: Neither the students nor the teacher is available.
examples.incorrect: Neither the students nor the teacher are available.

rules.trap: 考试中优先使用就近一致。

rules.title: not only...but also 的并列主语
rules.core: 连接两个主语时通常遵循就近一致；连接其他成分时保持平行即可。
rules.method: 先确定该结构连接的是主语还是谓语/宾语。

examples.correct: Not only the researchers but also the director is attending.
examples.incorrect: Not only the researchers but also the director are attending.

rules.trap: 不要把 but also 后的名词误当普通插入语。

rules.title: each, every, either, neither, one
rules.core: 这些词作主语或限定主语时通常按单数处理，即使后面有 of + 复数名词。
rules.method: 抓住 each/every/one 本身。

examples.correct: Each of the samples is labeled.
examples.incorrect: Each of the samples are labeled.

rules.trap: each of + 复数名词仍是单数。

rules.title: a number of 与 the number of
rules.core: a number of 表示“许多”，谓语复数；the number of 表示“数量”，谓语单数。
rules.method: 根据冠词 a/the 判断中心意思。

examples.correct: A number of studies have confirmed the result. / The number of studies has increased.
examples.incorrect: The number of studies have increased.

rules.trap: 两种结构外形相近但主语不同。

rules.title: 百分比、分数与部分量
rules.core: percent, half, most, some, all 等结构的单复数取决于 of 后名词：可数复数用复数，不可数/单数用单数。
rules.method: 看 of 后真正被分割的对象。

examples.correct: Most of the data are available. / Most of the water is clean.
examples.incorrect: Most of the water are clean.

rules.trap: data 在正式SAT语境中常按复数处理。

rules.title: 时间、金钱、距离与整体数量
rules.core: 作为一个整体单位时常用单数谓语；强调多个独立单位时可用复数。
rules.method: 问句子是在谈一个总量还是多个对象。

examples.correct: Ten years is a long time.
examples.incorrect: Ten years are a long time.

rules.trap: 数学表达或总金额也常按单数。

rules.title: 书名、作品名和学科名
rules.core: 即使标题形式为复数，作为一部作品或一个名称时通常用单数谓语。
rules.method: 把整个标题替换成 it。

examples.correct: Great Expectations is a novel.
examples.incorrect: Great Expectations are a novel.

rules.trap: 引号或斜体中的标题整体视为一个单位。

rules.title: 动名词、不定式和从句作主语
rules.core: 一个动作概念或一个完整从句作主语时通常按单数处理。
rules.method: 把整个主语替换成 this activity/this fact。

examples.correct: Analyzing the samples takes time. / What the team discovered is important.
examples.incorrect: Analyzing the samples take time.

rules.trap: 长主语容易让人误把内部名词当中心词。

rules.title: there is / there are 与倒装
rules.core: there/here 不是实际主语，谓语与后面的真正主语一致。
rules.method: 把句子还原为“真正主语 + 谓语”。

examples.correct: There are several explanations.
examples.incorrect: There is several explanations.

rules.trap: 不要只看句首 there。

rules.title: 关系从句中的主谓一致
rules.core: 关系词 who/which/that 的数由先行词决定，从句谓语与先行词一致。
rules.method: 把关系词替换成先行词。

examples.correct: The devices that measure pressure are new.
examples.incorrect: The devices that measures pressure are new.

rules.trap: 从句中的谓语和主句谓语要分别判断。

rules.title: one of the ... who 与 the only one who
rules.core: one of the + 复数名词 + who 通常指复数名词，从句用复数；the only one who 指 one，从句用单数。
rules.method: 确定 who 的先行词。

examples.correct: She is one of the scientists who study coral. / She is the only one who studies coral.
examples.incorrect: She is one of the scientists who studies coral.

rules.trap: 不要一看到 one 就让所有后续动词都用单数。

chapters.label: 第6章
chapters.title: 代词指代与格
intro: 代词题必须同时检查“指谁、单复数、格、所有格和句法功能”。

headers: 原PDF重点：G0007、G0187-G0256（70题），并大量交叉出现在其他标签。

rules.title: 代词与先行词单复数一致
rules.core: 单数先行词用 it/he/she/one，复数先行词用 they/them；物主形式也必须一致。
rules.method: 把代词替换成先行词，检查数是否匹配。

examples.correct: The device stores its data. / The devices store their data.
examples.incorrect: The devices store its data.

rules.trap: 不要被更近但不是先行词的名词吸引。

rules.title: 指代必须清楚
rules.core: 代词应有唯一、明确、逻辑合理的先行词；若句中有多个同数名词，常需要重复名词。
rules.method: 问“它/他们究竟指哪一个”。

examples.correct: The team revised the model because the model was inaccurate.
examples.incorrect: The team revised the model because it was inaccurate.

rules.trap: 后句中 it 可能指 team 或 model，需根据语意判断是否歧义。

rules.title: 主格与宾格
rules.core: 作主语用 I/he/she/we/they/who；作动词或介词宾语用 me/him/her/us/them/whom。
rules.method: 遮住并列的另一项，单独测试代词。

examples.correct: The director invited Maya and me.
examples.incorrect: The director invited Maya and I.

rules.trap: 介词 between 后必须用宾格。

rules.title: who 与 whom
rules.core: who 在从句中作主语，whom 作动词或介词宾语；whose 表所有关系。
rules.method: 把从句改成 he/him：能用 he 则 who，能用 him 则 whom。

examples.correct: The scientist who led the study spoke. / The scientist whom the team consulted spoke.
examples.incorrect: The scientist whom led the study spoke.

rules.trap: 不要只看前面的介词或名词，要看关系词在从句内部的角色。

rules.title: 物主限定词与物主代词
rules.core: my/your/his/her/its/our/their 后必须接名词；mine/yours/hers/ours/theirs 可独立使用。
rules.method: 看后面是否紧跟名词。

examples.correct: The team published its findings. / The findings are theirs.
examples.incorrect: The team published theirs findings.

rules.trap: its 既不是 it is，也不带撇号。

rules.title: its 与 it's
rules.core: its 表“它的”；it's 只能是 it is 或 it has 的缩写。
rules.method: 把 it's 展开测试。

examples.correct: The device lost its signal. / It's operating normally.
examples.incorrect: The device lost it's signal.

rules.trap: 所有格代词不加撇号。

rules.title: their / there / they're
rules.core: their 是所有格，there 表地点或存在句，they're = they are。
rules.method: 根据空格后的词判断：后接名词常需 their；后接形容词/分词可能需 they're。

examples.correct: The researchers published their results. / They're available online.
examples.incorrect: The researchers published they're results.

rules.trap: 同音词必须按句法功能选。

rules.title: 反身代词
rules.core: myself/yourself/himself/herself/itself/ourselves/themselves 只能反指同一分句中的主语，或用于强调。
rules.method: 若句中没有对应主语，反身代词通常错误。

examples.correct: The researcher introduced herself. / The researcher herself verified the data.
examples.incorrect: The director spoke with Maya and myself.

rules.trap: 不要把反身代词当“更正式”的普通宾格。

rules.title: 指示代词 this/that/these/those
rules.core: this/that 指单数，these/those 指复数；用于概括前文时，最好加具体名词使指代清楚。
rules.method: 检查数和具体指向。

examples.correct: These results support the hypothesis. / This finding is important.
examples.incorrect: This support the hypothesis.

rules.trap: 裸 this 指整件事时可能含糊，SAT常偏好 this finding/this pattern。

rules.title: one/ones 与 that/those 的替代
rules.core: one/ones 替代可数名词；that/those 常在比较中替代前面的单数/复数名词，避免重复。
rules.method: 保持单复数和语意类别一致。

examples.correct: The climate of Mars differs from that of Earth.
examples.incorrect: The climate of Mars differs from those of Earth.

rules.trap: 比较时替代词要与被替代名词同数。

rules.title: 关系代词的选择
rules.core: who/whom/whose 通常指人；which 指物或整件事；that 常用于限制性从句指人或物。
rules.method: 先判断先行词，再判断从句中缺什么成分。

examples.correct: The artist who created the mural lives nearby.
examples.incorrect: The artist which created the mural lives nearby.

rules.trap: 非限制性 which 从句前通常有逗号。

rules.title: 人称和视角一致
rules.core: 同一语境中不要无理由从 one 切换到 you/they，或从第三人称切换到第一人称。
rules.method: 检查段落中的泛指主体是否保持一致。

examples.correct: A reader can adjust the settings to suit the reader's needs.
examples.incorrect: A reader can adjust the settings to suit your needs.

rules.trap: SAT常考不一致的人称转换。

chapters.label: 第7章
chapters.title: 修饰语
intro: 修饰语必须靠近被修饰对象，并在逻辑上由该对象执行或承受动作。

headers: 原PDF重点：G0008-G0010、G0257-G0267（11题），以及大量“句法与语意完整性”题。

rules.title: 句首分词短语的逻辑主语
rules.core: 句首 -ing/-ed 短语默认修饰紧接其后的主句主语；该主语必须能合理执行或承受分词动作。
rules.method: 问“谁在做句首动作”。

examples.correct: Using satellite data, the researchers mapped the coast.
examples.incorrect: Using satellite data, the coast was mapped by the researchers.

rules.trap: 被动主句常造成悬垂修饰。

rules.title: 过去分词表示被动或完成
rules.core: -ed/过去分词修饰的名词应是动作的承受者；-ing 分词通常表示主动或进行。
rules.method: 判断名词与动作的主动/被动关系。

examples.correct: Designed for cold climates, the device operates efficiently.
examples.incorrect: Designing for cold climates, the device operates efficiently.

rules.trap: 不要只根据时间选择分词，要看逻辑关系。

rules.title: 修饰语应紧邻被修饰词
rules.core: 介词短语、分词短语和关系从句应尽量靠近所修饰的名词，避免歧义或错位。
rules.method: 把修饰语移动到不同名词旁，观察意思是否改变。

examples.correct: The team tested a sensor designed for deep water.
examples.incorrect: Designed for deep water, the team tested a sensor.

rules.trap: 后者暗示团队为深水而设计。

rules.title: 限制副词的位置
rules.core: only, almost, nearly, just, even 等应放在它真正限制的成分前，位置变化会改变意思。
rules.method: 问“只有谁/只做什么/几乎多少”。

examples.correct: The sensor detects only temperature changes.
examples.incorrect: Only the sensor detects temperature changes.

rules.trap: 两句都可语法正确，但含义不同。

rules.title: 形容词与副词
rules.core: 形容词修饰名词或作系动词补语；副词修饰动词、形容词、副词或整个句子。
rules.method: 看被修饰对象是什么。

examples.correct: The result was significant. / The result changed significantly.
examples.incorrect: The result changed significant.

rules.trap: feel, seem, become, remain 等系动词后常用形容词。

rules.title: 同位语与被说明名词
rules.core: 同位语必须紧邻它所解释的名词，并保持数和身份逻辑一致。
rules.method: 删除同位语，检查核心句；再检查同位语是否确实重命名前项。

examples.correct: The method, a form of indirect measurement, is widely used.
examples.incorrect: A form of indirect measurement, researchers use the method.

rules.trap: 句首名词短语若无清晰对应对象，可能形成悬垂结构。

rules.title: 关系从句的就近修饰
rules.core: 关系从句通常修饰它前面最近且语意合理的名词。
rules.method: 把 who/which/that 替换成最近名词测试。

examples.correct: The team interviewed artists who work in metal.
examples.incorrect: The team interviewed the gallery who works in metal.

rules.trap: 关系从句不能越过不相关名词寻找先行词。

rules.title: 比较短语的逻辑修饰
rules.core: compared with, unlike, similar to 等开头的比较短语应与主句主语形成同类比较。
rules.method: 检查比较短语中的对象和主句主语是否同类。

examples.correct: Compared with the old model, the new model is faster.
examples.incorrect: Compared with the old model, researchers found the new model faster.

rules.trap: 后者把 researchers 与 old model 比较。

chapters.label: 第8章
chapters.title: 动词形式与非谓语
intro: 先判断句子是否缺谓语，再在限定动词、不定式、动名词和分词之间选择。

headers: 原PDF重点：G0268-G0302（35题），并与“句法与语意完整性”高度交叉。

rules.title: 限定动词与非谓语的根本区别
rules.core: 每个分句需要限定动词；非谓语不能单独承担完整句的谓语。
rules.method: 若句中已有谓语且没有连接词，空格通常需要非谓语；若没有谓语，通常需要限定动词。

examples.correct: The team analyzed the samples. / The team, analyzing the samples, noticed a pattern.
examples.incorrect: The team analyzing the samples.

rules.trap: 数谓语是动词形式题的第一步。

rules.title: 不定式 to do
rules.core: 不定式可表示目的、结果、计划，或作名词/形容词/副词成分；不能单独作主句谓语。
rules.method: 看前面是否有需要 to do 的动词、名词或目的结构。

examples.correct: The team used the sensor to measure salinity.
examples.incorrect: The team to measure salinity.

rules.trap: to 也可能是介词，介词后需名词或动名词。

rules.title: 动名词 doing
rules.core: 动名词在句中作名词，可作主语、宾语或介词宾语。
rules.method: 若空格位于介词后或承担名词功能，考虑 -ing。

examples.correct: Measuring salinity requires calibration. / The method is useful for measuring salinity.
examples.incorrect: For measure salinity, the team calibrated the sensor.

rules.trap: 不要把所有 -ing 都当进行时。

rules.title: 现在分词 doing
rules.core: 现在分词常作修饰语或构成进行时，表示主动/进行关系。
rules.method: 若前有 be，可能是进行时；若无 be，通常是修饰成分。

examples.correct: The sensor measuring salinity is new. / The sensor is measuring salinity.
examples.incorrect: The sensor measuring salinity.

rules.trap: 第二个例句有完整谓语，第一句的 measuring 只修饰 sensor。

rules.title: 过去分词 done
rules.core: 过去分词可构成完成时、被动语态，或作被动/完成意义的修饰语。
rules.method: have + done 是完成时；be + done 多为被动；单独 done 常作修饰语。

examples.correct: The samples were collected in June. / The samples collected in June were frozen.
examples.incorrect: The samples collected in June.

rules.trap: 过去分词本身通常不能充当限定谓语。

rules.title: 完成分词 having done
rules.core: 表示分词动作先于主句动作发生，常用于强调先后关系。
rules.method: 只有当“先完成，再发生主句动作”的关系明确时才使用。

examples.correct: Having reviewed the data, the team revised the model.
examples.incorrect: Having reviewed the data, the model was revised.

rules.trap: 仍要检查逻辑主语，不能因完成式而忽略悬垂修饰。

rules.title: 助动词后的固定形式
rules.core: modal + 动词原形；have + 过去分词；be + 现在分词构成进行时；be + 过去分词构成被动。
rules.method: 先认助动词，再匹配后续形式。

examples.correct: can detect / has detected / is detecting / was detected
examples.incorrect: can detected / has detect / is detecteding

rules.trap: 选项常故意把助动词和错误词形混搭。

rules.title: 主动与被动的选择
rules.core: 主语执行动作时用主动；主语承受动作且施事者不重要或由 by 引出时用被动。
rules.method: 问“主语是谁，谁做动作”。

examples.correct: Researchers developed the method. / The method was developed by researchers.
examples.incorrect: The method developed researchers.

rules.trap: 语态必须与句意和句法结构同时匹配。

rules.title: 并列动词的形式平行
rules.core: 由 and/or/but 连接并共享主语或助动词的动词，应保持相同形式。
rules.method: 找并列词两侧的动词结构。

examples.correct: The device collects data and transmits them.
examples.incorrect: The device collects data and transmitting them.

rules.trap: 若前面有 has，则后面并列项也应是过去分词。

rules.title: 常见动词补语结构
rules.core: 部分动词后接不定式，部分接动名词，部分接“宾语 + to do”；SAT主要通过句法和固定搭配判断。
rules.method: 观察动词后是否已有宾语，并检查选项结构。

examples.correct: The program enables students to practice. / The team avoided repeating the error.
examples.incorrect: The program enables to practice students.

rules.trap: 高频：allow/enable/require + object + to do；avoid/consider + doing。

rules.title: with + 名词 + 非谓语
rules.core: with 后可形成附带结构：with + 名词 + doing/done/形容词/介词短语，表示伴随状态。
rules.method: 判断名词与非谓语的主动或被动关系。

examples.correct: The experiment ended with the participants waiting outside.
examples.incorrect: The experiment ended with the participants waited outside.

rules.trap: with 结构内部通常不用限定过去式。

chapters.label: 第9章
chapters.title: 动词时态、语态与语气
intro: 时态由时间标志、事件先后和语境功能决定，而不是由单个词决定。

headers: 原PDF重点：G0303-G0341（39题），并在其他标签中反复出现。

rules.title: 一般现在时：事实、规律和当前状态
rules.core: 科学事实、定义、习惯和当前普遍状态通常用一般现在时。
rules.method: 看句子是否描述恒常事实，而非特定过去事件。

examples.correct: A magnesium atom has twelve protons.
examples.incorrect: A magnesium atom had twelve protons.

rules.trap: 背景材料即使谈历史人物，科学定义仍可用现在时。

rules.title: 一般过去时：已完成的过去事件
rules.core: 有明确过去时间或历史叙述时用一般过去时。
rules.method: 寻找 in 1903, last year, during the war 等完成时间标志。

examples.correct: The city opened the museum in 1998.
examples.incorrect: The city has opened the museum in 1998.

rules.trap: 现在完成时通常不与明确结束的过去时间连用。

rules.title: 现在完成时：过去至今
rules.core: have/has + 过去分词表示过去发生并延续到现在、反复发生或对现在有影响。
rules.method: 常见标志：since, for, in recent years, so far, over the past decade。

examples.correct: Researchers have identified several patterns in recent years.
examples.incorrect: Researchers identified several patterns in recent years.

rules.trap: 若上下文强调“截至现在”，优先考虑现在完成时。

rules.title: 过去完成时：过去中的更早事件
rules.core: had + 过去分词用于两个过去事件中更早发生的一个。
rules.method: 先画时间线：A先发生，B后发生且两者都在过去。

examples.correct: By the time the team arrived, the storm had ended.
examples.incorrect: By the time the team arrived, the storm ended.

rules.trap: 若先后关系已由 before/after 十分清楚，过去完成时不一定必需，但题目会按语境选择。

rules.title: 将来表达
rules.core: will + 原形表示预测或未来事实；be going to 常表示计划或有迹象的预测。
rules.method: 看时间点是否明确在未来。

examples.correct: The mission will launch next year.
examples.incorrect: The mission launched next year.

rules.trap: 不要因主句现在时而忽略未来时间标志。

rules.title: 进行时
rules.core: be + doing 强调某一时刻正在进行或暂时状态，不适合表达恒常事实。
rules.method: 问动作是否处于进行过程。

examples.correct: The team is testing the device now.
examples.incorrect: The device is containing three sensors.

rules.trap: contain, know, belong 等状态动词通常不用进行时。

rules.title: 时态一致与叙述中心
rules.core: 同一时间层次的并列动作通常保持时态一致；变化必须有明确的时间逻辑。
rules.method: 找段落的主时间轴。

examples.correct: The researcher collected the samples and analyzed them.
examples.incorrect: The researcher collected the samples and analyzes them.

rules.trap: 不要为了形式多样而无理由换时态。

rules.title: 被动语态中的时态
rules.core: 被动语态是 be 的相应时态 + 过去分词；时态信息体现在 be 上。
rules.method: 先选时间，再选主动/被动。

examples.correct: The bridge was completed in 2010. / The bridge has been repaired twice.
examples.incorrect: The bridge has repaired twice.

rules.trap: 完成被动为 has/have been + done。

rules.title: 条件句与虚拟关系
rules.core: 真实条件常用 if + 现在时，主句 will；与过去事实相反常用 if + had done, would have done。
rules.method: 判断条件是可能、假设还是与事实相反。

examples.correct: If the temperature rises, the reaction will accelerate. / If the sensor had failed, the team would have repeated the test.
examples.incorrect: If the sensor would have failed, the team had repeated the test.

rules.trap: 不要在普通 if 条件从句中机械使用 will。

rules.title: 时间从句中的将来
rules.core: when, before, after, until 等时间从句谈未来时，常用一般现在时，主句用 will。
rules.method: 从属词已表达未来关系，时间从句通常不用 will。

examples.correct: When the mission launches, scientists will monitor the signal.
examples.incorrect: When the mission will launch, scientists will monitor the signal.

rules.trap: 这是标准英语中的常见时态搭配。

chapters.label: 第10章
chapters.title: 句法与语意完整性
intro: 原PDF中的最大标签覆盖多种实际现象。本章按“句子需要什么成分”重新拆解。

headers: 原PDF重点：G0342-G0898（557题）。该标签含谓语、代词、标点、从句、非谓语和语意完整性等交叉题。

rules.title: 句子片段：只有短语没有谓语
rules.core: 分词短语、不定式短语、介词短语和同位语不能单独成为完整句。
rules.method: 寻找主语和限定动词。

examples.correct: The sculpture is installed in Burnley.
examples.incorrect: The sculpture installed in Burnley.

rules.trap: 选项越长不代表越完整。

rules.title: 句子片段：只有从属分句
rules.core: 从属连词或关系词引导的分句必须附着在独立分句上。
rules.method: 删除从属词，观察原结构是否只是缺主句。

examples.correct: Because the material is light, it is easy to transport.
examples.incorrect: Because the material is light.

rules.trap: 句号不能把从属分句独立出来。

rules.title: 混合结构 (mixed construction)
rules.core: 句子开头建立一种结构后，后面必须按该结构完成，不能中途换框架。
rules.method: 读到空格前，预测后面需要名词、从句还是谓语。

examples.correct: The reason the method works is that it reduces friction.
examples.incorrect: The reason the method works is because of reducing friction.

rules.trap: “the reason is that”比“the reason is because”更符合正式结构。

rules.title: 名词从句
rules.core: that, whether, what, how, why 等可引导名词从句，整体作主语、宾语或补语；从句内部仍需完整。
rules.method: 确定空格是否需要一个“事实/问题/内容”。

examples.correct: The study shows that the method works.
examples.incorrect: The study shows the method works it.

rules.trap: that 可省略时也必须保证从句结构清楚。

rules.title: 关系从句
rules.core: 关系从句修饰名词，关系词在从句内部承担主语、宾语或所有格功能。
rules.method: 先找先行词，再检查从句缺什么。

examples.correct: The method that the team developed is efficient.
examples.incorrect: The method that the team developed it is efficient.

rules.trap: 关系词已作宾语时，不要再重复代词。

rules.title: 状语从句与介词短语的区别
rules.core: because/although/while 后接完整从句；because of/despite/during 后接名词或动名词。
rules.method: 看连接词后是否有主语+谓语。

examples.correct: The test was delayed because the sensor failed. / The test was delayed because of sensor failure.
examples.incorrect: The test was delayed because of the sensor failed.

rules.trap: 连词和介词不能混用。

rules.title: such as / including 的语法层级
rules.core: such as 和 including 引出例子或附加名词，不引出独立分句，也不承担主谓连接。
rules.method: 检查后面是否是名词列表。

examples.correct: The study examined metals such as copper and zinc.
examples.incorrect: The study examined metals such as copper is conductive.

rules.trap: 需要完整句时应改用 for example, copper is conductive。

rules.title: 并列结构中的省略
rules.core: 并列项可共享主语、助动词或介词，但省略后仍须结构清晰、形式平行。
rules.method: 把省略部分补回，检查两项是否完整。

examples.correct: The device can collect data and transmit them.
examples.incorrect: The device can collect data and transmitting them.

rules.trap: 共享 can 时，两个动词都用原形。

rules.title: 陈述句与疑问句语序
rules.core: 嵌入式疑问从句使用陈述语序；直接疑问句才使用助动词倒装。
rules.method: 看问号是否属于整个句子，还是疑问内容嵌入主句。

examples.correct: Researchers asked why the signal changed.
examples.incorrect: Researchers asked why did the signal change.

rules.trap: whether/why/how 引导的名词从句不倒装。

rules.title: 形式主语 it 与存在句 there
rules.core: it 可作形式主语，真正主语后置；there 引出存在关系，真正主语在后。
rules.method: 确认 it/there 是否有明确句法功能，而非模糊指代。

examples.correct: It is important to calibrate the sensor. / There are two possible explanations.
examples.incorrect: There is two possible explanations.

rules.trap: 存在句还要检查主谓一致。

rules.title: 倒装与比较中的助动词
rules.core: 在 than/as 比较或地点倒装中，助动词可替代前文谓语，保持句子完整并避免重复。
rules.method: 补回省略的谓语测试。

examples.correct: The sampled group responded faster than did the control group.
examples.incorrect: The sampled group responded faster than the control group did responded.

rules.trap: 助动词 did 已替代 responded。

rules.title: 逻辑主语与语意完整
rules.core: 即使句法形式成立，也要保证动作的执行者、受事者和因果关系合理。
rules.method: 问“谁做什么，谁被影响”。

examples.correct: The researchers used the method to estimate the rate.
examples.incorrect: The rate used the researchers to estimate the method.

rules.trap: 专业词不熟也能通过角色关系排除。

rules.title: 固定搭配与介词选择
rules.core: 部分形容词、名词和动词要求固定介词；介词后接名词/代词/动名词。
rules.method: 观察选项是否只改变介词或后续词形。

examples.correct: responsible for measuring / capable of detecting / based on evidence
examples.incorrect: capable to detect / based in evidence

rules.trap: 先确保结构正确，再根据语意选搭配。

chapters.label: 第11章
chapters.title: 平行结构
intro: 并列或对比的成分必须具有相同语法形式和层级。

headers: 原PDF显式标签：G0901；但平行结构也广泛分布在动词形式、句法和比较题中。

rules.title: 列表中的平行
rules.core: 并列名词、动词、形容词、短语或从句应保持同一形式。
rules.method: 找到 and/or 以及逗号列表，比较每一项的词性和结构。

examples.correct: The job requires collecting data, analyzing results, and writing reports.
examples.incorrect: The job requires collecting data, to analyze results, and reports.

rules.trap: 并列项必须处于同一层级。

rules.title: 并列谓语平行
rules.core: 共享主语或助动词的谓语应使用一致形式。
rules.method: 补回共享成分。

examples.correct: The sensor can detect motion and measure distance.
examples.incorrect: The sensor can detect motion and measures distance.

rules.trap: modal can 后两个动词都用原形。

rules.title: 关联连词平行
rules.core: both...and, either...or, neither...nor, not only...but also 两侧必须连接同类成分。
rules.method: 比较连词后紧接的结构。

examples.correct: The method is both accurate and inexpensive.
examples.incorrect: The method both is accurate and inexpensive.

rules.trap: both 的位置决定它连接什么。

rules.title: 比较结构平行
rules.core: than 和 as 两侧应比较同类成分，必要时重复助动词或使用 that/those。
rules.method: 把省略部分补全。

examples.correct: The new sensor is more accurate than the old one is.
examples.incorrect: The new sensor is more accurate than the old one accuracy.

rules.trap: 比较不仅要语意同类，也要语法形式可对应。

chapters.label: 第12章
chapters.title: 所有格与撇号
intro: 先判断是否存在“所有关系”，再决定单数所有格、复数所有格或普通复数。

headers: 原PDF显式标签：G0902-G0980（79题）；该区也混入其/它是、复数和其他结构题，因此本章按实际撇号规则整理。

rules.title: 普通复数不加撇号
rules.core: 名词只是表示多个时，通常直接加 -s/-es；撇号不用于制造普通复数。
rules.method: 问句中是否表达“谁的”。

examples.correct: The researchers published several studies.
examples.incorrect: The researcher's published several study's.

rules.trap: 先判断数，再判断所有关系。

rules.title: 单数名词所有格
rules.core: 单数名词通常加 \’s，表示所属、来源、组成或关联。
rules.method: 把结构改写成“of + 名词”测试。

examples.correct: the scientist's discovery = the discovery of the scientist
examples.incorrect: the scientists discovery

rules.trap: 不要因单数名词以 s 结尾就漏掉撇号。

rules.title: 规则复数名词所有格
rules.core: 以 s 结尾的复数名词通常只在 s 后加撇号。
rules.method: 先确认名词本身已经是复数。

examples.correct: the researchers' findings
examples.incorrect: the researcher's findings（若指多位研究者）

rules.trap: 撇号位置反映单复数。

rules.title: 不规则复数所有格
rules.core: 不以 s 结尾的不规则复数按单数形式处理，加 \’s。
rules.method: 识别 children, people, men, women 等。

examples.correct: children's books / people's choices
examples.incorrect: childrens' books

rules.trap: 先写正确复数，再加所有格。

rules.title: 以 s 结尾的专有名词
rules.core: 现代正式英语通常可写 James's / Charles's；具体考试选项会依据统一风格。核心是保持形式一致并确认所有关系。
rules.method: 比较选项时优先选择完整、统一的所有格形式。

examples.correct: James's theory
examples.incorrect: James theory

rules.trap: 若来源材料只提供某一风格，按选项和句法判断。

rules.title: 共同所有与分别所有
rules.core: 两人共同拥有同一物，只在最后一人后加 \’s；分别拥有时，两人都加所有格。
rules.method: 问是一个共同对象还是各自对象。

examples.correct: Maya and Leo's laboratory / Maya's and Leo's laboratories
examples.incorrect: Maya's and Leo laboratory

rules.trap: 名词单复数也会提示共同或分别所有。

rules.title: 复合名词和长短语的所有格
rules.core: 复合名词或整体短语通常在最后一个词后加 \’s。
rules.method: 把整个所有者视为一个单位。

examples.correct: the editor in chief's decision
examples.incorrect: the editor's in chief decision

rules.trap: 撇号放在整个所有者短语末尾。

rules.title: 时间、距离和价值的所有格
rules.core: 表示时间、距离、价值等度量关系时可用所有格。
rules.method: 可改写为“of”或相应量词结构。

examples.correct: a day's work / two weeks' notice
examples.incorrect: two week's notice

rules.trap: 单数 day's，复数 weeks'。

rules.title: 物主代词不加撇号
rules.core: its, yours, hers, ours, theirs, whose 本身已经是所有格，不加撇号。
rules.method: 检查撇号形式能否展开成“is/has”。

examples.correct: The device lost its signal. / Whose data are these?
examples.incorrect: The device lost it's signal. / Who's data are these?

rules.trap: it's = it is/has；who's = who is/has。

rules.title: 缩写与所有格的区分
rules.core: 撇号可能表示省略，也可能表示所有格；必须根据后续结构判断。
rules.method: 尝试展开缩写，并检查后面是否需要名词。

examples.correct: They're reviewing their data over there.
examples.incorrect: Their reviewing they're data.

rules.trap: 同音形式是SAT高频陷阱。

chapters.label: 第13章
chapters.title: 比较结构
intro: 正确比较要求对象同类、数量一致、范围清楚，并使用合适的比较级形式。

headers: 原PDF显式标签：G0139-G0141、G0981-G0985；实际比较题也散见修饰语、主谓一致和句法标签。

rules.title: 同类事物比较
rules.core: 必须比较同一类别的对象：人的作品与人的作品、城市人口与城市人口，而不是作品与人。
rules.method: 把比较两端写成完整名词短语。

examples.correct: The climate of Mars differs from that of Earth.
examples.incorrect: The climate of Mars differs from Earth.

rules.trap: 后者字面上比较 climate 与 Earth。

rules.title: that/those 替代重复名词
rules.core: that 替代单数名词，those 替代复数名词，用于保持比较对象一致。
rules.method: 根据被替代名词的数选择。

examples.correct: The wings of this species are larger than those of the other species.
examples.incorrect: The wings of this species are larger than that of the other species.

rules.trap: 不要把复数 wings 与单数 that 对应。

rules.title: 比较级与最高级
rules.core: 两者比较用比较级；三者或以上、在一个范围内选最突出者用最高级。
rules.method: 看比较范围和 than/of/in 结构。

examples.correct: Of the three models, this one is the fastest.
examples.incorrect: Of the three models, this one is faster.

rules.trap: 比较级前通常不用 the，最高级通常用 the。

rules.title: 避免双重比较
rules.core: 不要同时使用 more + -er 或 most + -est。
rules.method: 检查形容词是否已经带比较级/最高级词尾。

examples.correct: more efficient / faster / most reliable
examples.incorrect: more faster / most reliableest

rules.trap: 长形容词常用 more/most，短形容词常用 -er/-est。

rules.title: as...as 与 than 的完整结构
rules.core: 同级比较用 as + 原级 + as；比较级通常与 than 搭配。
rules.method: 检查比较标志和形容词形式是否匹配。

examples.correct: The new sensor is as accurate as the old one. / It is more accurate than the old one.
examples.incorrect: It is as more accurate as the old one.

rules.trap: 不要混合两套结构。

rules.title: fewer/less 与 number/amount
rules.core: fewer/number of 通常修饰可数复数；less/amount of 修饰不可数名词。
rules.method: 判断名词能否逐个计数。

examples.correct: fewer errors / less time / the number of samples / the amount of water
examples.incorrect: less errors / the amount of samples

rules.trap: 时间、金钱、距离作为整体时常用 less。

rules.title: 比较范围排除自身
rules.core: 一个成员与同组其他成员比较时，常用 any other、all other 等排除自身。
rules.method: 检查是否出现“自己比自己更……”的逻辑问题。

examples.correct: The Nile is longer than any other river in Africa.
examples.incorrect: The Nile is longer than any river in Africa.

rules.trap: 后者把 Nile 也包含在 any river 中。

rules.title: than/as 后的省略与代词格
rules.core: 比较从句可省略重复谓语，但省略后逻辑必须清楚；代词格取决于省略结构。
rules.method: 补全隐含谓语。

examples.correct: She runs faster than I do. / The team contacted Maya more often than me.
examples.incorrect: She runs faster than me do.

rules.trap: 若省略 do/is 等，主格与宾格可能产生不同含义。

rules.title: between 与 among
rules.core: between 通常用于两个明确对象或逐一关系；among 用于三个以上的群体内部。
rules.method: 看关系是否是两两对应还是群体内部。

examples.correct: a comparison between the two models / variation among the five samples
examples.incorrect: variation between the five samples（群体一般关系）

rules.trap: 现代英语允许 between 用于多项逐一关系，但SAT会偏好语意最精确的形式。

chapters.label: 第14章
chapters.title: 综合易错点与考场检查表
intro: 把所有规则压缩成可在20-30秒内执行的检查顺序。

items: 离动词最近的名词不一定是主语。
句子很长不代表需要逗号；先找主干。
however/therefore 不是并列连词。
冒号前必须完整，动词或介词后不能直接加冒号。
关系词已在从句中作成分时，不再重复 it/them。
句首分词短语必须修饰紧随其后的主语。
its/their/whose 是所有格，不加撇号。
一个分句不能同时塞入两个没有连接关系的限定动词。
比较必须同类，并排除被比较对象自身。
语法正确不等于逻辑正确，最后检查动作执行者和时间线。
圈出限定动词，判断有几个分句。
检查空格两侧是否都是完整句。
若考标点：先判句界，再判必要/非必要信息。
若考动词：先判缺不缺谓语，再判主谓、时态、语态。
若考代词：找先行词，检查单复数、格和清晰度。
若考修饰语：问“谁在做动作”，检查就近修饰。
若考撇号：先判复数，再判所有关系。
若考比较：把两端写完整，确认同类和范围。
把答案放回原句，检查是否出现句子残缺、重复谓语或逻辑荒谬。

rows: 句号 / 分号 / 逗号 / 无标点
单数动词 / 复数动词
has done / had done / did / does

appendices.title: 标点决策树
intro: 只要先判断空格两侧的完整性，大多数标点题可以机械化完成。

rows: 步骤1：空格两侧都是独立分句 -> 句号 / 分号 / 逗号+FANBOYS；若使用连接副词 -> 分号+连接副词+逗号。 步骤2：前面是完整句，后面解释/列举 -> 冒号或单破折号。 步骤3：空格包围可删除信息 -> 一对逗号 / 一对破折号 / 一对括号。 步骤4：空格位于主谓、动宾、介宾之间 -> 通常不加标点。 步骤5：普通词语列表 -> 逗号；复杂列表内部已有逗号 -> 分号。
